ports.name: New Orleans
ports.provenance: USCG Light List Volume IV (Gulf Coast), 2024 Ed., LLNR 0425 / NOAA Nautical Chart 11361. Stored prototype test coordinate [-89.4300, 28.9000] approximates published Southwest Pass Entrance Lighted Horn Buoy SW (28°54'21"N, 89°25'43"W; -89.428611, 28.905833) with a reproducible geodesic offset of 660.6 m (0.357 NM). NGA Pub. 150 Index 51860.
ports.license: U.S. Federal Government Public Domain (17 U.S.C. § 105)
ports.access_limitations: Prototype test input; NOT a certified navigational coordinate. Outer fairway entrance to Southwest Pass jetty channel. Mississippi River terminal berths at New Orleans (River Mile 95 AHP) are ~90 NM inland under Crescent River Port Pilots. City centroid (29.95°N, -90.07°W) is over 65 NM inland.

ports.name: Yokohama
ports.provenance: Japan Coast Guard (JCG) Hydrographic Dept Chart W1062 / Tokyo Wan Traffic Route Guide (cited secondary source). Stored prototype test coordinate [139.7300, 35.1500] approximates claimed Uraga Suido Traffic Separation Scheme southern entry gate (35°09.5'N, 139°44.0'E; 139.733333, 35.158333) with a reproducible geodesic offset of 973.1 m (0.525 NM). The cited JCG URL is a general institutional portal and does not directly retrieve a public coordinate record online; source coordinate is therefore classified as unverified. NGA Pub. 150 Index 61440.
ports.license: Official Navigational Notice (Japan Coast Guard; Japanese State Copyright / public safety terms; NOT U.S. Public Domain)
ports.access_limitations: Prototype test input; NOT a certified navigational coordinate. Uraga Channel TSS deep-water entrance gate to Tokyo Bay. Inner transit to Honmoku and Daikoku terminals requires Tokyo Bay Pilotage (~15 NM channel passage). Inner harbor centroid (35.45°N, 139.65°E) is separate.

ports.name: Seattle
ports.provenance: NOAA Nautical Chart 18480 / Coast Pilot 7; published entrance junction for Strait of Juan de Fuca (48°30.0'N, 124°45.0'W; -124.750000, 48.500000) used in NGA Pub. 151 and adjacent to USCG LLNR 16110 Buoy JA. Stored prototype test coordinate [-124.7500, 48.5000] matches the published Cape Flattery entrance reference coordinate exactly (0.0 m offset). However, this point represents the outer ocean entrance of the Strait of Juan de Fuca at Cape Flattery, which is 125 NM away from Seattle terminal berths in Elliott Bay; it is classified as an approximate macro approach gate, not a verified terminal access point for Seattle.
ports.license: U.S. Federal Government Public Domain (17 U.S.C. § 105)
ports.access_limitations: Prototype test input; NOT a certified navigational coordinate. Cape Flattery pilot boarding area / TSS western entrance at ocean boundary. Vessels transit 125 NM through the Strait of Juan de Fuca and Puget Sound to reach Elliott Bay terminal berths.

The cited MPA URL is a general pilotage landing page and does not directly retrieve an authoritative coordinate record online; source coordinate is therefore classified as unverified.
